title.narrative: Strengthening climate readiness and agency in South Asia

description.narrative: The UNESCO Regional Office for South Asia will expand Education for Sustainable Development (ESD), including through the Greening Education Partnership (GEP), to strengthen climate readiness and agency among learners and communities in South Asia, in line with Intersectoral Priority 2 (IP2). During the 2026–2027 biennium, the UNESCO Regional Office for South Asia will consolidate and scale up its leadership in Education for Sustainable Development (ESD) and Greening Education, supporting Member States to mainstream climate action, sustainability, and environmental stewardship across education systems. Building on concrete national and state level initiatives already undertaken in the region, the Office will prioritize systemic transformation of education through policy alignment, curriculum reform, teacher professional development, and community engagement. As the Secretariat to the Greening Education Partnership, special emphasis will be placed on implementing UNESCO’s Greening Curriculum Guidance and the Green School Quality Standard—in partnership with governments, education authorities, civil society, and youth networks in India, Sri Lanka, Maldives and Bhutan.
